title: The Undetected Damage of Quantization on Retrieval and How to Fix It
abstract: arXiv:2609.24322v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We show that a quantized model that keeps its classification accuracy still changes $14$ to $46\%$ of its top-1 retrieval results, and that aggregate ranking metrics reveal only part of this damage. We tie this failure to the gap between the two highest scores and use that gap to decide when a quantized answer can be trusted and where additional precision should be spent. We show that the top-1 result is guaranteed to survive quantization only when this gap exceeds twice the largest rounding error. In classification, scores are the logits, and the loss function pushes the correct class away from other classes, encouraging this gap. In retrieval, scores are query-document scores, and nothing separates the top-1 item from the second. This gap can be measured without labels. translated_title: 量化对检索造成的未被察觉的损害及其修复方法
translated_abstract: 我们发现，一个保持分类准确率的量化模型仍会改变其14%至46%的top-1检索结果，而聚合排序指标只能揭示这种损害的一部分。我们将这种失败与两个最高分数之间的差距联系起来，并利用该差距来判断量化答案何时可信以及应在何处投入额外的精度。我们证明，只有当该差距超过最大舍入误差的两倍时，top-1结果才能保证在量化后保持不变。在分类任务中，分数是logits，损失函数会推动正确类别远离其他类别，从而促进这种差距的形成；而在检索任务中，分数是查询-文档分数，没有任何机制将top-1项与第二项区分开。该差距可以在无标签的情况下进行测量：在部署之前，它可以预测哪些模型在量化后会失效；在部署时，它可以针对每个输入判断量化答案是否仍与全精度答案一致。
tldr: 量化模型即使分类准确率不变，仍会悄悄改变14%至46%的top-1检索结果；论文提出利用最高两个分数之间的差距（可无标签测量）来判断量化答案是否可信，并证明只有当该差距超过最大舍入误差的两倍时，top-1检索结果才能保证不变。
en_tdlr: Quantized models silently alter 14–46% of top-1 retrieval results even when classification accuracy is preserved; this work shows that the gap between the two highest scores—measurable without labels—predicts this failure and guarantees top-1 survival only when it exceeds twice the largest rounding error.
